biotools.summary: Open tool that ranks existing drugs for each disease in a biomedical knowledge graph (PrimeKG extended with Open Targets and STRING) and shows the evidence behind every candidate. Only candidates backed by evidence checked against held-out data are shown, with how often each kind of evidence was right. Includes OREVID-bench, a public, reproducible drug-repurposing benchmark with TxGNN run on the same splits. Research use only: it generates hypotheses and is not a clinical tool.
